skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts, theories, and practical issues related to labor economics.
Analyze the factors influencing the labor market, including macroeconomic, firm-specific, and individual factors.
Apply quantitative and qualitative research techniques to analyze labor market issues.
Evaluate the impact of labor market policies on market outcomes.
Conduct independent and group research on labor market issues.
Apply economic theories to real-world labor market scenarios.
Solve labor market problems using economic theories and research methods.
Work effectively in teams to analyze and synthesize economic and social issues.
Communicate research findings effectively in written and oral formats.
Initiate and manage independent research projects.
